clue.text: Old quack doctor working by trial and error

definitions.meaning: an archaic word for a charlatan physician relying on experience rather than science
an adjective for proceeding by experiment and observation rather than theory

explanation.definitionFit: The word served as a noun for an unscientific practitioner and as an adjective for experimental method.

clue.text: Some in the club go topless? They'll get cooler!

indicators.note: going topless means losing the top, the first letter in a down light

parts.note: club members are some of those belonging to it

explanation.surface: Club members strip off and feel the chill.
explanation.definitionFit: Glowing remnants of a fire gradually cool down as they fade.

clue.text: Thespian in theatrical company written up in the past

indicators.note: written up in a down light means read upwards, reversed

parts.note: REP is a repertory theatre company
former means belonging to the past, earlier

explanation.surface: An actor in a drama troupe was reviewed long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: A thespian is an actor, someone who acts on stage.

clue.text: Wine makers have no time for bookworms

indicators.note: having no time means losing a T, the abbreviation for time

parts.note: grapes are trodden by treaders to make wine

explanation.surface: Winemakers are too busy for avid readers.
explanation.definitionFit: Bookworms are avid people who devour books.

clue.text: All the hard cases are put in this class

definitions.text: All the hard cases are put in this class

parts.words: All the hard cases are put in this class
parts.note: a zoological class of animals with hard shells, not tough people in a school class

explanation.definitionFit: This zoological class comprises crabs, lobsters and similar creatures with hard shells.

clue.text: On the wagon, journalist became less reckless

parts.note: being on the wagon means abstaining from alcohol, so not drunk
ED, short for editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A newspaper writer gives up drink and calms down.
explanation.definitionFit: To be brought to a soberer state is to grow more serious and less rash.

clue.text: One in flight has a fixed gaze when speaking

indicators.note: when speaking means the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a stare is a fixed gaze

explanation.surface: A passenger on a plane stares while talking.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight of steps is made of single steps, each one part of it.

clue.text: Live diocese overseeing church petition

indicators.note: overseeing in a down light means placed above the next piece

parts.note: to be is to live or exist
a see is a bishop's diocese

explanation.surface: A living diocese oversees a church's petition.
explanation.definitionFit: To petition is to plead or implore earnestly.

clue.text: Sat on old horses here

parts.note: sat on a horse means rode

explanation.surface: Old horses were ridden at this event.
explanation.definitionFit: At a rodeo, cowboys ride horses and bulls in competition.

clue.text: Player needing the other half

parts.note: a musician playing in a pair needs a partner to complete the performance

explanation.definitionFit: A performer of duets needs a second player to complete the piece.

clue.text: Marine attacker Cuba radar picked out

indicators.note: picked out suggests the letters are selected and rearranged in a new order

explanation.surface: A sea predator is spotted by Cuban radar.
explanation.definitionFit: This toothy predatory fish is a fearsome hunter of the sea.

clue.text: Son found loaf to steal

parts.note: to loaf is to laze about, to be idle

explanation.surface: A boy discovered bread to pinch.
explanation.definitionFit: To steal along means to move furtively, creeping sideways unseen.

clue.text: Wine department

definitions.meaning: a wine from the valley of the great French river
an administrative region of France named after that river

explanation.definitionFit: The name labels both a regional French wine and a French administrative area.

clue.text: Dismissed to get dressed

definitions.meaning: dressed up, as in well ..., smartly attired

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means expelled, and also describes someone attired or kitted out.

clue.text: Game in which others may leave you standing

definitions.text: Game in which others may leave you standing

parts.words: Game in which others may leave you standing
parts.note: a party game where the player left without a seat when the music stops is out, literally standing

explanation.definitionFit: In this party game, the loser is the one left on their feet with nowhere to sit.

clue.text: Rejecting quiet English horn playing in opera

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are being performed in a new arrangement

parts.note: SH is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: An orchestra rejects a noisy cor anglais played in an opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rejecting' says the letters of SH are removed from the mixed letters of ENGLISH HORN.
explanation.definitionFit: Wagner wrote this opera about a swan knight.

clue.text: Having curiosity aroused by conspiracy over diamonds

indicators.note: over in a down light means placed above

parts.note: an intrigue is a secret plot or conspiracy
D is the card abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: Someone is fascinated by a plot about jewels.
explanation.definitionFit: Being fascinated means one's curiosity is roused.

clue.text: Father overlooking behaviour that may be improper

indicators.note: overlooking in a down light means placed above

parts.note: FR is the abbreviation for Father, a priest
an action is a piece of behaviour

explanation.surface: A priest ignoring bad conduct that may be improper.
explanation.walkthrough: An improper fraction has a numerator greater than its denominator, such as 7/4.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics, a vulgar quotient whose top exceeds the bottom is called improper.

clue.text: Blotting paper useful for this personality exam?

definitions.text: Blotting paper useful for this personality exam?

parts.words: Blotting paper useful for this personality exam?
parts.note: a psychological test uses symmetrical ink blots, which blotting paper might produce

explanation.definitionFit: This projective psychological test asks subjects to interpret ink blots, revealing personality traits.

clue.text: Piece of mischief may go wrong

parts.note: can is a synonym for may, expressing possibility
to trip is to slip up or go wrong

explanation.surface: A prank can easily backfire.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scots word for a witch's spell or a playful trick.

clue.text: Advocacy of select group within arbitrary English limits

indicators.note: arbitrary suggests random order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Support for an elite circle within random English boundaries.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the belief that a select few should hold power or advantage.

clue.text: Inferior, like others on the board?

definitions.meaning: resembling the items on a cheese board

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means tacky or second-rate, and literally like cheese.

clue.text: Make rapid escape from fall with ladder

parts.note: a cut is a reduction or fall, as in a price cut
with means and, joining two things
a ladder in tights is a run

explanation.surface: Someone flees after a tumble involving a ladder.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to flee hastily rather than stay and face trouble.

clue.text: Silent, returning in arctic atmosphere

indicators.note: returning says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A quiet, cold atmosphere returns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' signals that the letters are taken from inside 'arctic atmosphere'.
explanation.definitionFit: Unspoken and implied, this adjective means understood without words.

clue.text: Fighter pilot admitted, by the way, to have speeded

indicators.note: admitted means let in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
an ace is an expert fighter pilot

explanation.surface: A pilot was let onto the road to hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: To speed and to race both mean to go very fast.

clue.text: Woman touching hearts of the people

indicators.note: touching means placed right next to, in contact

parts.note: Iris is a woman's name
H is the card abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: A woman moves the hearts of ordinary folk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The people' here are the people of Ireland, so the adjective describes what belongs to them.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means belonging to a particular nation, the people of Ireland.

clue.text: Become subject to contract

definitions.meaning: to bring something like a penalty or debt upon oneself
to contract, as one contracts debts or obligations

explanation.definitionFit: Taking on a liability or debt is both falling subject to it and contracting it.

clue.text: Church, blunt about religious book, shows conviction

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: about means around, so one word encloses the other

parts.note: blunt speech is rude
Tit. is the abbreviation for Titus, a book of the New Testament

explanation.surface: A frank church member, holding a holy book, shows firm belief.
explanation.definitionFit: Conviction and this word both mean complete certainty of belief.

clue.text: Rejected college flat in block

indicators.note: rejected means turned back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school, Eton College
a pad is slang for a flat or home

explanation.surface: A student is refused a flat in an accommodation block.
explanation.definitionFit: A writing block is a pad of paper sheets for jotting notes.

clue.text: Annual celebration may end with a blow-out

indicators.note: a blow-out scatters things, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A yearly party may end with a big feast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blow-out' looks like the party itself but signals the anagram of MAYEND plus A.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the yearly feast of the saint one is named after, celebrated like a birthday.
